'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Russo-Ukrainian war]]
**[[Attacks in Russia during the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Attacks in Russia during the Russo-Ukrainian war]]
***[[Kursk campaign]]
****The [[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian military]] reports that it used [[United States]]-made weapons to destroy several [[pontoon bridge]]s constructed by [[Russia]] following its destruction of at least three bridges over the [[Seym (river)|Seym river]] in [[Kursk Oblast]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraine-says-it-hits-pontoon-bridges-russia-moscow-reports-gains-2024-08-21/ (Reuters)]
***[[Mayor of Moscow]] [[Sergey Sobyanin]] states that Ukraine launched one of its largest [[drone warfare|drone attacks]] on the [[Moscow|Russian capital]], and claims that all drones were taken down without casualties or damage based on preliminary information. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraine-launches-drone-attack-moscow-other-regions-russian-officials-say-2024-08-21/ (Reuters)]
**[[Eastern front of the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Eastern Ukraine campaign]]
***[[Pokrovsk offensive]]
****The [[Russian Ministry of Defense]] states it has fully captured the village of [[Zhelanne]] in [[Donetsk Oblast]], [[Ukraine]]. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/russia-ukraine-war/russia-claims-it-took-control-of-another-settlement-in-ukraine-s-donetsk-region/3309596 (Anadolu Agency)]
****[[President of Ukraine|Ukrainian President]] [[Volodymyr Zelenskyy]] acknowledges advancements made by [[Russian Armed Forces]] on the [[Pokrovsk, Ukraine|Pokrovsk]] front, and announces the strengthening of regional [[Ukrainian Ground Forces|Ukrainian positions]] in order to resist further advancements. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/zelenskiy-says-ukraine-is-boosting-its-forces-east-resist-russian-advance-2024-08-21/ (Reuters)]
*[[Islamist insurgency in the Sahel]]
**[[Burkina Faso]], [[Mali]], and [[Niger]] write to the [[United Nations Security Council]] to denounce [[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] support for rebel groups in the [[Sahel region]] of [[West Africa]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/west-african-juntas-write-un-over-ukraines-alleged-rebel-support-2024-08-21/ (Reuters)]
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[List of Palestinian rocket attacks on Israel in 2024|2024 Palestinian rocket attacks on Israel]]
***Hamas fires two rockets from the [[Gaza Strip]] with sirens sounding in [[Sderot]], [[Ibim]], and [[Nir Am]]. [https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20240823-israel-army-reports-2-rockets-fired-from-gaza-towards-southern-israel/ (Middle East Monitor)]
*[[Israeli incursions in the West Bank during the Gaza war]], [[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]], [[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**One injured in Hezbollah launching 50 rockets, drone strikes and shelling on IDF's Tsnobar logistics site and several other IDF sites in the [[Golan Heights]] and [[Zar'it]] in [[northern Israel]].[https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/8/21/israels-war-on-gaza-live-israel-bombards-gaza-lebanon-us-says-deal-near (Al Jazeera)]
**A Syrian national and Khalil al-Muqdah, a commander in the [[Al-Aqsa Martyrs' Brigades]], is killed in an [[Israel]]i [[airstrike]] in [[Sidon]] and [[Khiam]] in [[southern Lebanon]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/8/21/israels-war-on-gaza-live-israel-bombards-gaza-lebanon-us-says-deal-near?update=3130720 (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/8/21/israels-war-on-gaza-live-israel-bombards-gaza-lebanon-us-says-deal-near (Al Jazeera)]
**One killed and two injured in an Israeli airstrikes on a Hezbollah ammunition depot, an air defense system and the villages of [[Abu Sash]], [[Wadi Hamool]], [[Aita al-Shaab]], [[Ramiya]] and [[Talousa]] of the [[Beqaa Valley]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/8/21/israels-war-on-gaza-live-israel-bombards-gaza-lebanon-us-says-deal-near (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**Nine people, including five security officers and four civilians are killed and dozens are injured in an [[Al-Shabaab (militant group)|Al-Shabaab]] [[Suicide attack|suicide]] [[car bomb]] attack on a [[security checkpoint]] on the [[Mogadishu]]–[[Afgooye|Afgoye]] highway in [[Somalia]]. [https://www.nationalaccordnewspaper.com/10-die-in-mogadishu-suicide-car-bombing/ (''Daily Post Nigeria'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Unemployment in the United States]]
**The [[United States Department of Labor]] issues a significant estimate correction stating that the [[Economy of the United States|U.S. economy]] added 818,000 fewer jobs between April 2023 and March 2024 than what was initially reported in July, the largest estimate revision since 2009. [https://apnews.com/article/jobs-hiring-employers-workers-government-labor-department-eae6b26b76136cf4936fbc781f79c2f4 (AP)] [https://www.cnbc.com/2024/08/21/nonfarm-payroll-growth-revised-down-by-818000-labor-department-says.html (CNBC)]
*[[2024 Canada railway shutdown]]
**[[Canada]]'s two largest [[rail freight transport|freight railroads]] [[Canadian Pacific Kansas City]] and [[Canadian National Railway]] announce a [[2024 Canada railway shutdown|complete shutdown of services]] due to a contract dispute, shutting out its [[Teamsters Canada|Teamsters]]-represented union workers. [https://www.reuters.com/business/autos-transportation/canadian-national-railways-canadian-pacific-lock-out-teamsters-union-workers-2024-08-22/ (Reuters)] [https://apnews.com/article/canadian-railroad-unions-cpkc-csx-a8b705c9b2e69bb8a8bc97d28f0be23c (AP)]
*With regards to the rapid growth of the [[artificial intelligence]] market, [[Bloomberg L.P.|Bloomberg]] alleges that technology companies are "concealing their actual [[carbon footprint]]s" by invoking outdated [[carbon accounting|emissions accounting]] rules. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2024-08-21/ai-tech-giants-hide-dirty-energy-with-outdated-carbon-accounting-rules/ (Bloomberg)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Atchutapuram pharmaceutical factory explosion]]
**At least seventeen workers are killed and 41 others are injured, many from severe [[chemical burn]]s, in an explosion at a [[Pharmaceutical industry in India|pharmaceutical facility]] in [[Anakapalli]], [[Andhra Pradesh]], [[India]].  [https://indianexpress.com/article/india/skin-peeling-off-chemical-burns-andhra-reactor-blast-killed-14-broken-homes-9526074/ (''Indian Express'')] [https://www.ndtv.com/india-news/18-injured-in-explosion-at-andhra-pradesh-pharma-company-6385152 (NDTV)]
*Twenty-eight people are killed and 23 others are injured when a bus carrying [[Shia Islam|Shia]] [[Pakistanis|Pakistani]] pilgrims to the [[Arba'in pilgrimage]] in [[Iraq]] crashes and overturns in [[Yazd province]], [[Iran]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/28-killed-23-injured-bus-accident-carrying-pakistani-pilgrims-iran-isna-reports-2024-08-21/ (Reuters)]
*Four bodies are recovered from the [[superyacht]] ''[[Bayesian (yacht)|Bayesian]]'' that sank two days ago, bringing the death toll to five. The search for the last missing person is ongoing. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/search-resumes-six-missing-after-mike-lynchs-yacht-sank-hopes-dim-2024-08-21/ (Reuters)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2023–2024 mpox epidemic]]
**[[Thailand]] reports its first case of [[mpox]] in a 66-year-old European man who worked in an [[Africa]]n country affected by the ongoing epidemic. [https://www.nytimes.com/2024/08/21/world/asia/thailand-mpox.html (''The New York Times'')]
**Several suspected cases of mpox clade 1b are reported in [[Somerset]], [[England]], [[United Kingdom]]. [https://www.devonlive.com/news/health/suspected-monkeypox-case-identified-devon-9499313.amp (Devon Live)]
**[[Honduras]] reports five suspected cases of the new mpox [[clade]]. [https://www.prensalibre.com/internacional/honduras-investiga-cinco-supuestos-casos-de-viruela-simica-dentro-de-una-familia/ (''Prensa Libre'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Hungary and the Russo-Ukrainian war]], [[Hungary–Ukraine relations]]
**A [[Law of Hungary|Hungarian law]] restricting or removing state support and accommodations for [[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] [[Ukrainian refugee crisis|refugees]] not from regions directly affected by the [[Russian invasion of Ukraine|Russian invasion]] comes into effect. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/ckg2jxjd7r7o (BBC News)]
*[[Sanski Most school shooting]]
**Three staff members are killed in a [[mass shooting]] at a school in [[Sanski Most]], [[Bosnia and Herzegovina]]. The perpetrator, who also worked at the school, is seriously injured after shooting himself. [https://apnews.com/article/bosnia-school-shooting-employee-8047c11fda2bb9bcee0a9d25c903072f (AP)]
*Four people, including three children, are killed in a house fire in [[Bradford]], [[England]], [[United Kingdom]]. Police say that the fire was [[arson|started deliberately]] and that a suspect has been arrested under suspicion of [[murder]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cp9r48nzx33o (BBC News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[International reactions to the 2024 Venezuelan presidential election]]
**The [[United States]] drafts a punitive [[Sanctions (law)|sanctions]] list of sixty [[Government of Venezuela|Venezuelan government officials]] from the country's [[National Electoral Council (Venezuela)|National Electoral Council]], [[Supreme Tribunal of Justice (Venezuela)|Supreme Court]], and [[General Directorate of Military Counterintelligence|counterintelligence police agency]] for alleged [[electoral fraud]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/us-drafts-list-60-venezuelans-possible-sanctions-over-election-sources-say-2024-08-21/ (Reuters)] 
*The [[Verkhovna Rada|Ukrainian parliament]] approves the [[Rome Statute]] treaty established by the [[International Criminal Court]], thereby allowing the country to become a state party once the [[Government of Ukraine|government]] [[ratification|ratifies]] with the [[Secretary-General of the United Nations]]. [https://www.ukrinform.ua/rubric-polytics/3897252-rada-ratifikuvala-rimskij-statut.html (Ukrinform)]
